svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.8 STAIRS, RAMPS, LANDINGS, HANDRAILS AND GUARDS
Guards for Floors and Ramps in Garages
Where garage floors or ramps are 600 mm (23⅝″)
or more above the adjacent ground or floor,
every opening through the floor, and the
perimeter of floors and ramps with no exterior
(a) a continuous curb not less than 140 mm (5½″)
high, and (b) a guard not less than 1 070 mm
(3′-6⅛″) above the floor level. Except floors of
constructed to withstand the loading values in
Drawn: an upper garage floor with an open edge and a floor opening. Gold is the curb. Guard details are illustration only.
